verdict.rationale: Spline's own file-level Version History lets users preview saved versions, track changes, manually save versions and recover earlier file states. Because Spline's automations (states, events, actions, webhooks, Real-time API calls) live inside the file, this covers versioning and rollback of them indirectly, not as automation-specific version control. missing for 10: automation-level versioning separate from whole-file snapshots, diff or review workflow for automation changes, documented granular rollback of individual automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: This feature helps you track changes, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions as needed.
Version History allows you to access and preview all the saved versions of your files.
